# Superintendent Bell

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Sunday-school superintendent  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Superintendent Bell is characterized by his gray whiskers and spectacles. His appearance is described as consistent, looking much the same as an adult as he does when imagined as a child.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Superintendent Bell is regarded as a genuinely good man.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010)_

- good  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P10](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0010)</sub>
